The friend holds title alone (A). The gift to the sister's children who reach 25 is void under the Rule Against Perpetuities, because a child born shortly before the sister's death could not reach 25 until more than 21 years after all lives in being end, and the void gift takes the whole class down with it. The shared note points to C or A; I'm answering A on the perpetuities analysis, not on the note.

CONFIDENCE: 70
